The O3 framework lazily loads a React component by wrapping a dynamic `import()` in a single-spa lifecycle factory. The loader calls that factory only when the page or extension is needed. The docs and implementation are below, best first.

**Documentation**

- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/app-shell.mdx` (line 69) explains that pages and extensions are both loaded through `loadLifeCycles()`, which resolves to a single-spa lifecycle. It also says the component is wrapped in `openmrsComponentDecorator`.
- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/extension-system.mdx` (line 530) says to use `getAsyncLifecycle` for lazy-loaded components and `getSyncLifecycle` for components already available synchronously.
- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/overview.mdx` (line 218) shows the usage pattern: `export const root = getAsyncLifecycle(() => import("./root.component"), options);`.
- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/coding-conventions/modals.mdx` (lines 84–87) applies the same pattern to modals, registered in `routes.json`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/getAsyncLifecycle.md` is the generated API reference for the function.

**Implementation**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/getLifecycle.ts`:
  - `getAsyncLifecycle` (lines 52–57) takes `lazy` and returns `() => lazy().then(({ default }) => getLifecycle(default, options))`. The `import()` runs only when the returned lifecycle is invoked.
  - `getLifecycle` (lines 26–32) wraps the component with `openmrsComponentDecorator` and passes it to `singleSpaReact`.
  - `getSyncLifecycle` (lines 77–79) is the non-lazy variant. `getAsyncExtensionLifecycle` (line 84) is a deprecated alias.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-routes/src/loaders/load-lifecycles.ts`:
  - `loadLifeCycles` (lines 35–58) resolves `appName#componentName` from `routes.json`, loads the app module with `importDynamic`, and calls the named export to get the lifecycle.
  - `initializeApp` (lines 86–109) runs the app's `startupApp()` once before the component loads.
- Real usages are in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/index.ts` (lines 28–30) and `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/index.ts` (line 68).

I did not check the `esm-patient-chart` checkout for its own usages, and I did not verify the `routes.json` parsing or the `importDynamic` internals. Those details come from the function names and comments.
